beta3d.name: Beta3D
beta3d.description: Enables beta features in the 3D calculator.

betterKeypad.name: Better Keypad
betterKeypad.description: Adds Greek letter, copy/paste and selection keys to the on-screen keypad.

bottomExpressions.name: Bottom Expressions
bottomExpressions.description: Forces expression list to be on bottom.

core.name: Core
core.description: Core patches used to load extensions.

desmosMd.name: Desmos Markdown
desmosMd.description: Adds markdown support to notes in the calculator.

limitlessLists.name: Limitless Lists
limitlessLists.description: Raises the 10,000 element cap on lists to 100,000,000.

lua.name: Lua
lua.description: Lua scripting cells in the expression sheet. Add one from the + menu, or type "lua" into an empty expression. A cell reads the graph's values as globals and exports its own the same way, straight to the evaluator, so nothing is added to the graph. Cells run when the graph opens and when you click the play button in the gutter, but never because you typed in one. A cell whose first line reads "--!lua unsafe" is given the page itself and only ever runs on a click.

matrices.name: Matrices
matrices.description: Enables the use of matrices outside the Matrix Calculator.

monospace.name: Monospace
monospace.description: Changes the font of notes and folder labels to monospace.

patchHelper.name: Patch Helper
patchHelper.description: A tool to help with writing extensions.

settings.name: Settings
settings.description: Adds a settings pane to the saved graphs list.

shapes.name: Shapes
shapes.description: Enables the use of shapes outside the Geometry Calculator.
